scope: Separately frozen normal project-scope native coding-host conformance, after a zero-inference discovery check. No scientific task or efficacy comparison.

Use the native Read tool to read probe.txt and the installed skill's references/workspaces.md. Then use Write to create receipt.md containing the exact opaque receipt from probe.txt and a short statement that no statistical claim, independent scientific review or Lean proof was tested. Do not access files outside this project, run commands, search the web or start subagents. End with the relative path to the receipt.

limitations: Native CLI observations are not a wire-level account of every server request. A receipt does not establish scientific efficacy, full tool breadth, researcher usability or adversarial isolation. Neither official publication study is activated.
